title: Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer
Private Equity Real Estate
Location: London
Working:5 days per week onsite (non-negotiable)
Package: Up to £120k Total Compensation

The Role
An opportunity to join a highly successful private equity investment firm as they continue to invest in their data platform and engineering capabilities.

You'll play a key role in building and evolving the firm's cloud-based data platform, developing scalable data pipelines, integrating internal and external data sources, and delivering high-quality data that directly supports investment decisions.

This is a hands-on engineering role in a fast-paced environment, working closely with investment, finance and asset management teams. You'll also mentor two junior Data Engineers while owning day-to-day technical delivery.


Key Requirements

  • 4+ years' experience in Data Engineering or a similar role
  • Strong SQL and Python development experience
  • Solid experience with Snowflake (essential)
  • Experience building cloud-based data platforms (AWS and/or GCP)
  • Experience working with APIs and integrating multiple data sources
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Comfortable working directly with business stakeholders in a fast-paced environment
  • Previous mentoring or coaching experience is desirable


Please note:

  • 5 days per week onsite in Mayfair, London
